title: What's a Fish Doing on the Roof?

collection.credit: NEW EVENTS — WHAT'S THAT DOING HERE? (WD-01 to WD-50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)

ledger.why: the casting line (the roles carry it)
the draft's effect note, never shown: the page's effect

collection.description: A fresh fish lies on a villager's roof while a seabird circles above: give it back to the bird, or keep it.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: There's a fish on (name1)'s roof. A whole fish, quite a big one, fresh, lying on the thatch as though it has been neatly delivered. A seabird is circling overhead, crying in what sounds very much like frustration.

choices.label: Give It Back to the Bird

a.name: Answer A
a.text: (name1) gets the fish down and lays it on a rock in the open. The seabird swoops down, grabs it, and flies off without a word of thanks. (name1) goes back inside. A moment later, there's a thump on the roof. (He/She) goes out. The bird has dropped it again. (name1) looks up at the bird. The bird looks down at (name1).

b.name: Answer B
b.text: (name1) gets the fish down and, after a moment of guilt, cooks it for dinner. It's very good. The seabird sits on the roof all evening, glaring down through the smoke hole. The next morning, (name1) leaves a few scraps out on the rock for it, as an apology. The bird eats them, still glaring.
